summary: The current failures consistently show integer precision adding one extra digit across static, dynamic, positional, and width-plus-precision printf formats. The available source excerpts do not include the printf parsing and integer formatting implementation, so the cause and relevant boundary behavior cannot yet be established.
hypotheses: The printf adapter translates an explicit integer precision to a digit count with an off-by-one error.
The zero flag and explicit precision interact incorrectly when printf specs are converted to the shared integer writer.
Dynamic precision resolution may use a different conversion path from static precision.
